about: Topic values for the viewer's case editor (the 'topic' dropdown). A case text with a topic gets it as the corpus line's "topic" field, so nli_label.py --topic-field topic (hint / trust / off) can be tested on the cases. The policy's topic_map decides which subject a value stands for (e.g. History -> history). Add values here, or with '+ new topic…' in the dropdown. Start: the WebOrganizer-style topic names some corpora carry.
